• The GDPR requires a controller to provide information about automated decision-making, including profiling, and to inform the data subject of the logic and consequences of such processing [C3].

• The GDPR requires a controller to provide a copy of personal data in a commonly used electronic form if the request is made by electronic means [C3].
• The GDPR allows a controller to refuse to act on a request if it is manifestly unfounded or excessive, and to charge a reasonable fee in such cases [C0].
